stem:
Use “Good Enough” to answer the following question.

This question has two parts.

Part A
How does the characterization of the man contribute to the theme of the story “Good Enough”?

options.label: A
options.text: The man’s neediness suggests that it is important to offer help to those who require it.

options.label: B
options.text: The man’s strength shows that people should not be judged by their appearance.

options.label: C
options.text: The man’s determination in the face of struggle teaches that people should not be afraid to encounter failure.

options.label: D
options.text: The man’s cheerfulness reveals that a positive outlook has the power to lift the spirits of others.
